# Mutually active navigation sound effects (2026-01-30 08:58Z)

_**User**_

Currently when navigation is on there is a logic which detects wether both devices are actively navigating/requesting their locations. If both are actively navigating a "mutually active" text is shown in the bottom-access-modifier and a color overlay is added to the route.

This also seems to be debounced/hysteresis gated.

When the "mutually active" flag is turned on I want to play a sound effect - a short sound - also when it is deactivated.

It should be a subtle but noticeable sound effect, representing that both devices monitor each other and "navigating towards each other
